software.name: casablan
software.notes:
512 bytes/sector, 9 sectors/track, 80 tracks/side.
Track 38 Side 1 Sector 5 has an invalid byte sequence encoded at its DAM sequence marker offset. Manually fixing this sequence still results in flaky reads due to jitter in 4us MFM pulse interval (no pulses in 6uS and 8uS).

software.name: tetris
software.notes:
512 bytes/sector, 9 sectors/track, 80 tracks/side.
Track 1 Side 1 contains empty sectors 2 to 5 (image bytes 0x3800..0x4000) with invalid data CRCs: expected 0xDA6E, but stored checksum is 0x5445 (ASCII encoded "TE"). These sectors cover two non-standard overlapping FAT filesystem entries:
- File b"\x94" in cluster 9 with size 0x1400 bytes (image bytes 0x3800..0x4c00); - File b"\x94\x94" in cluster 10 with size 0x17e8 bytes (image bytes 0x3c00..0x53e8);
Image bytes 0x4000..0x6c00 duplicate file "OOO.PRG" at offset 0x800 (image offset 0x7400). This file is in cluster 22 with size 0x3080 bytes (image bytes 0x6c00..0x9c80).
